name: catalyst_unified_safe_expert_system_v1
goal: One benchmark-agnostic enzyme-reaction retrieval system whose capability coverage is broader than any single baseline while matching or exceeding the chosen authoritative baseline in every declared capability contract, with multiple contracts showing material >5 percentage-point gains on a primary Top-K metric.

system_strategy.default: authoritative baseline expert is the safe floor for its native capability contract
system_strategy.gain_path: Catalyst experts may replace or fuse with the baseline only under a low-capacity query-intrinsic gate selected on clean internal OOF data

r2e_sequence_reaction.scope: native or minimally support-adapted reaction-to-enzyme retrieval

e2r_sequence_reaction.scope: native or minimally support-adapted enzyme-to-reaction retrieval

r2e_native_molecule_bag.note: The confirmed Catalyst molecule-bag adapter expands input coverage but is not promoted as a score improvement by itself.

promotion_gate.per_contract_baseline_floor: On each declared contract, all primary metrics must be >= baseline - tolerance unless a predeclared cross-contract compensation rule is satisfied.
promotion_gate.material_breakthrough_definition: At least +5.0 percentage points on a primary Hit@K metric, or a comparably material relative/absolute gain on MRR/MAP/NDCG predeclared before confirmation.
promotion_gate.confirmation: Any newly selected unified gate/fusion must be frozen and committed before a fresh salted confirmation split is materialized.

evidence_policy.own_historical_models: ablation/evolution only, not the sole external baseline
evidence_policy.paper_reported_baseline_values: context unless locally reproduced on compatible support
evidence_policy.support_restriction: allowed only for predeclared input/mapping compatibility, never by target performance
